findings.claim: In desktop/topic-post.scss, `.topic-meta-data h5 a` has its dark-light-choose arguments swapped. The original light-theme `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(70%, 30%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`, so the light-theme link becomes much lighter and lower-contrast.

verifier.reason: At app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss:291 (patch lines 619-620), `.topic-meta-data h5 a` changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. Every other conversion in the patch keeps the original value as the first (light-theme) argument, for example the `.arrow` rule at line 294 (60%→60%/40%), so in the light theme this link goes from 30% to 70% lightness and loses contrast.

findings.claim: In mobile/modal.scss, `.custom-message-length` has its light/dark values swapped. The original 70% became `dark-light-choose(30%, 70%)` instead of `(70%, 30%)`, which disagrees with desktop/modal.scss.

verifier.reason: app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss:102 changes the original `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. desktop/modal.scss:94 uses `(... $primary 70%, ... $secondary 30%)`, so the two percentages are swapped on mobile and the light theme no longer keeps its original 70% value.

findings.claim: In desktop/user.scss and mobile/user.scss, `.group-member-info .name` was converted to `dark-light-choose(50%, 50%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`. This changes the light-theme lightness from 30% to 50%, the same as `.title`.

verifier.reason: In desktop/user.scss:522 and mobile/user.scss:497, `.group-member-info .name` changed from `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` to `dark-light-choose(... 50%, ... 50%)`. findings.claim: In topic-post, a rule whose original light-theme value was `$lightness: 70%` now uses `$lightness: 30%` for the light theme, making the text darker.

verifier.reason: No topic-post rule changes its light value from 70% to 30%. Every original 70% rule keeps 70% as the light argument (common/base/topic-post.scss:289-290, 298-299; desktop/topic-post.scss:677-679, 697-698; mobile/topic-post.scss:987-988). findings.claim: The expression `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, X%), scale-color($secondary, 100-X%))` is hand-copied 115 times across 32 files instead of being encoded once in a one-argument helper.

verifier.reason: All 115 added `dark-light-choose` lines in change.patch, across its 32 files, use the form `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: X%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: (100-X)%))` with matching percentages, for example 50/50, 40/60, 75/25 and 10/90. The only helper, `dark-light-choose` in common/foundation/variables.scss:46, takes two arguments, and no one-argument wrapper exists.
